svg.title: The rank ceiling and the two ways out of it
svg.desc: With linear working models every prediction lies in the span of the model block, which already contains the control-total block, so only q minus the dimension of the control-total block directions are left for study variables. Two escapes: a richer predictor basis enlarges the span and raises the ceiling by one variable at a time, while adaptive learners and cross-fitting produce predictions outside any single fixed span, so the ceiling no longer applies.
svg.text: span of the model block, dim q
what is left for study variables:
a richer predictor basis enlarges q
the ceiling moves up, and binds again one variable later
adaptive learners, or cross-fitting any model
predictions stop lying in one fixed span,
so the ceiling does not apply at all
Full rank is still not the same as well conditioned.
